info.title: proto-gen — Generate .proto schemas from compiled .NET assemblies.
info.description: CLI tool that scans compiled .NET assemblies for [ProtoContract] and [ProtoService] types, generates .proto schema files with configurable output routing, and optionally patches .csproj files to include the generated output.

options.name: --auto
options.description: Force guided/interactive mode even when arguments are provided.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be written without touching the file system.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print per-file message / service / import counts.

options.name: --help

arguments.name: ASSEMBLY
arguments.description: Path to the compiled DLL containing [ProtoContract] / [ProtoService] types.

arguments.name: OUTPUT_DIR
arguments.description: Override base output directory (default: ProtoPath from assembly attributes).
